text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, still feeling lost, I wander
back to the track. A
scrimmage is in full
swing, and it's livelier than usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
I can't believe C.B.'s really racing!
They're almost at the final
corner, which
means...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, here it comes... Her lightning dash
to the front!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after the race ends, the crowd is
teeming with
excitement—including one
particularly enthusiastic Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That was... amazing! So, so, sooo
AMAZING! Now I wanna run! I
wanna
ruuuuun!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, guys! What're you waiting for?
Let's gooooo!

text_block_list.name: Runaway Besties
text_block_list.text: Waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Seein' that got me all hyped up! Get ready
to eat my dust, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're going DOWN!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at her go! They're doing
2,400 meters, right?! She's getting faster
and faster...
Won't she run outta gas at this
rate?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(200 meters to go! I can hear Palmer and
Helios catching up! Three
meters behind?
Two meters? No, they're even closer!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(My legs feel heavy, and my chest hurts...
But I don't care!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I'll push my body to my limit, right here
on the turf! I'll keep running
faster and
faster—and further than anyone else!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heh... Heheheh!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff... Pheeeeew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, you all good, Ines? You really put
the pedal to the metal,
don't you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Heheh, I'm fine,
I'm fine! In fact, I
couldn't be better!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Haha,
I bet! You're totally giving off that
vibe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that Ines... She really does become
a totally different person in
the heat of the
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My heart pounds uncontrollably—the way
she ripped through the turf
like a wild
animal has me completely mesmerized.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not about to be outdone!
All right,
time to hit the gym and
pump some iron!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to take my eyes off Ines Fujin, I
silently watch as she takes a
breather...
until she notices me and walks over.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I remember you—from the other day
with the phone, right? I had
a feeling you
were a trainer here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You've been spying on me for a while now,
right? Need something?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, yep! I love it more than anything!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
When I run, my heart goes craaazy like
thump-thump! I can't help but
wanna go
faster and faster!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Then the moment I pull ahead, my whole
body tingles—it feels
amazing! I can't get
enough of it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to explain... But if you were an
Umamusume, you'd totally
know what I'm
talking about. I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haha, is that so? Oh, by the way, since
you watched the scrimmage
earlier...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
How did I do? Personally, I think I could
be even faster, so I'd love to
hear your
feedback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I recall Ines Fujin's races from the past
two days. There's no doubt—with her raw
speed and relentless drive to stay ahead,
she's
got the makings of a front runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That said, not all front runners are the
same. Some like to take control and
manipulate the pace, while others just
continuously race ahead without concern
for the others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to help her improve, I tell her that I'd need to see her run a lot more. That way, I can come up with a strategy that will work for her.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, interesting... Gotcha.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
In that case... You can be my temporary
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hear me out—this could be a solid
opportunity for you! The thing is,
I'll be
competing in the next Tracen Meet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tracen Meet is a school event where
runners choose their own
races to test and
showcase their potential.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My family will be there, and I really want
to show them the fruits of
my hard work!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But since self-training has its limits,
I've
been thinking about turning
to the pros for
help. And besides...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...You're not feeling super confident
about
being a trainer just yet,
right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I kinda overheard you at the restaurant...
Anyway, if we work
together, it might just
give you the confidence you need!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Which means this is a win-win deal for
both of us! So that settles
it—let's start
tomorrow! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how, in a surprising twist,
I end
up making a short-term
contract with Ines
Fujin.
